About Lunara

Lunara didn't begin with a business plan. It started with a spark and a lot of chaos.

Arthur had an idea: build something creative, something alive. He reached out to Abhi, and together they started small. Then came the name — the moon's quiet rhythm, its mystery, its power.

🌌 Lunara: See Beyond. Build Forward.

At first, it was about games. But Arthur had one of those corridor thoughts — why stop at games? What if Lunara was a space where anyone could create, code, design, edit, build, share, and grow?

Lunara's goal: to be the all-in-one app for creative community, music, games, tech, and more.
